**Sierra Extracts Co. is only moderately reliable on timing. They deliver on time 73% of the time.** Fill rate is excellent.

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| On-time % | 73% |
| Promised lead time | 14 days |
| Actual median lead time | 14.2 days |
| Lead time p90 | 26.2 days |
| Fill rate | 99.2% |
| Completed orders sampled | 11 |
| Open POs | 0 |
| Last ordered | 2026-10-14 |

- **Timing:** The median is close to the 14-day promise. The p90 of 26.2 days means roughly 1 in 10 orders takes nearly twice as long as promised. If you reorder from them, build in buffer. Plan around 26 days rather than 14 for critical SKUs.
- **Fill:** They ship almost everything ordered (99.2%).
- **Prices:** Their last price is about 3.8–3.9% above the 90-day average on all 9 products I can see. Each product has only 2 samples in that window, so it may be a small step increase rather than a trend.
